params.name: groupID
params.description: in: unique ID number of the group to modify, or -1/-2 to add a new group; out: unique ID number of the added group, if one was added.

sentinelValues.meaning: Add a new group, affiliated with the Designer (binary databases).
Add a new group, affiliated with the Administrator (binary databases only).

params.name: owner
params.description: Binary databases only; ignored in project databases.

overloads.semanticRole: Set group properties enables you to change and update the properties of an existing group whose unique group ID number you pass in groupID , or to add a new group.

constraints: The mechanical draft left groupID with direction 'in', but the doc's arrow column marks it '<->' (inout): it is both an input (group ID to modify, or -1/-2 to add) and an output (receives the new group's ID number when adding).
If groupID is not -1, -2, or a valid existing group ID, the command does nothing.
If members is omitted, the group's current member list is left unchanged (or the new group has no members, when adding); passing an empty members array removes all members.
